name: The Ritz-Carlton, San Francisco
insider_take: Nestled in the historic Nob Hill neighborhood, The Ritz-Carlton San Francisco is a landmark of timeless elegance, housed in a stunning Neoclassical building dating back to 1909.
whats_special: Occupying a stunning 1909 Neoclassical landmark building, the hotel seamlessly blends historic grandeur with modern Ritz-Carlton luxury. Perched atop iconic Nob Hill, guests enjoy breathtaking views of the city and easy access to San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods. The hotel's legendary service and world-class amenities, including a full-service spa and acclaimed dining, make it the gold standard of San Francisco luxury.
pro_tip: Request a Cable Car-facing room to watch San Francisco's iconic cable cars glide past your window — the California Street line runs right outside the hotel's doorstep, offering an only-in-SF experience you won't forget.
dont_miss: The Lobby Lounge: Indulge in the hotel's celebrated afternoon tea service, a San Francisco tradition since 1991, complete with finger sandwiches and fine pastries. Nob Hill Spa: Treat yourself to a rejuvenating treatment at this award-winning spa, renowned for its signature Nob Hill Ritual experience. Grace Cathedral: Just steps away, this stunning Gothic cathedral is a must-visit Nob Hill landmark, featuring magnificent stained glass and a famous outdoor labyrinth.
pros: Prime Nob Hill location with stunning city and bay views
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms and suites with classic luxury amenities
Close proximity to Union Square, Fisherman's Wharf, and cable cars
cons: Historic building with traditional room layouts
